main_body: A green sofa drawn from the front: a large light-green backrest panel (rows 1-5), a dark band, then a seat cushion and a dark base. It is a flat front view with small brown feet.
top_band: Light green rows 1-5 (L=142) is the backrest face, not a horizontal surface. There is no distinct top band separated by a step or edge line; the seat is only a thin 1-row highlight (row 8, row 11) between dark bands.
evidence: The column reads as stacked vertical faces: backrest (rows 2-5), dark gap (6-7), cushion highlight (8) and body (9-10), highlight (11), dark base (12-14). No seat surface is visible from above. The 1-row light lines at rows 8 and 11 are edge highlights, not top surfaces. This is the front-elevation failure from the guide, and the seat is only a thin band or edge, as in the red 'thin seat' case.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 5 distinct colours and a median of 5 per tile, against 17-20 per tile and 38-40 colours in the references. The shading is a few flat green bands with no texture dots, grain or stitching. The dark edge is a tinted dark green (0% neutral), so it is not a black sticker outline, but the large flat areas and the very low density still make it clearly thinner than the Beodeul pieces. The 5x5 flat-fill measure reads 0% only because the bands are short. By eye the fills are flat.
